name: Earthshape — an anthem already on the board reaches the earthbent land and raises the bound
notes: (2026-10-18, Conor: anthems would affect it.) Glorious Anthem was on the board before Earthshape, and the Forest had three +1/+1 counters put on before the spell. As the spell resolves the Forest is a 0/0 creature with three counters and the anthem's +1/+1: 4/4. The group is judged on that board (_resolutionBoard), so Hill Giant (4/4 under the anthem) qualifies; Craw Wurm (7/5) does not. Reading the land off the snapshot alone (it was no creature there, so the anthem never reached it) gave 3 and left Hill Giant out.
